## Description

Combines Neural Delay Differential Equations with Fourier Neural Operators to solve infinite-dimensional stochastic optimal control problems for multi-period portfolio optimization under memory lags.

## Where it may fit

Central bank policy transmission delays, multi-period asset allocation with memory effects, institutional portfolio rebalancing.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Global Macro Hedge Funds, Pension Portfolios.

## Required data

Multi-asset historical return series, policy announcement lag schedules, volatility surfaces.

## Caveats

Delay parameterization and functional space discretization require heavy GPU acceleration.
